product_one_liner.value: Blue Triangle measures digital friction and connects it to conversion and revenue so product, ecommerce, marketing, and engineering teams can prioritize fixes and assess their impact.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes the platform’s revenue connection and its intended teams.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists multiple plans and a custom-pricing Enterprise plan.

named_customers.notes: These are named on Blue Triangle’s homepage customer-logo area.

employee_band.notes: Revelio Labs reports approximately 30 employees in 2026 Q1, which falls in the 21-50 band; public estimates vary.

hq_location.notes: The jobs profile explicitly identifies Mechanicsville, United States as headquarters; the company privacy policy gives a Mechanicsville, Virginia address.

founded_year.notes: PitchBook identifies the founded year as 2011.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is primarily product announcements and marketing, ecommerce, podcast, and user-experience content; it does not establish two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public Help Center links to multiple articles, including a detailed MCP overview and integration/technical documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The job page reported no open roles as of 2026-11-09.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed AI Assistant and MCP materials describe supported external assistants, while the published subprocessor list names infrastructure providers but does not identify the underlying model provider for Blue Triangle’s built-in AI Assistant.

compliance_certs.notes: The Legal & Trust Center lists an SOC-2 report and ISO27001; normalized here as SOC 2 and ISO 27001.

last_funding.notes: The latest round is dated November 2021 and is identified as Series B by VCBacked; the amount is undisclosed, so 0 is used only as the schema-required neutral numeric value, not as a claim that the round raised zero dollars.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest reported round was in November 2021, well before the 18-month window ending 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The job page reported no open roles as of 2026-11-09.

launched_6mo.notes: A July 2026 announcement says Blue Triangle launched its Revenue Assurance layer, within the six-month window ending 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Emily Salzer’s profile gives a January 2026 start as Vice President of Customer Success, within the preceding 12 months; the company’s About page lists her in that role.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public MCP documentation includes workflows for HubSpot campaign analysis and ZoomInfo account segmentation.
